_: Verdicts settled AFTER the research file and the batch plans. audit:multi-approach reads this last, so an entry here overrides them.

wa_mount_adams_wilson_glacier_headwall.why: East side from Cold Springs to camp in Avalanche Valley; no ascent from the north side is recorded. Row made consistent in leftovers 4 and 7.

wa_storm_king_north_face.why: The 1978 first ascent came up Park Creek to the Goode-Storm King saddle and rappelled onto the north-side glacier; nothing describes another way. Approach written in leftovers 7.

wa_mount_si_trail.why: Flagged FINISH only because the Haystack scramble sits on top of it; the trail is itself the one way in.

wa_mount_si_haystack_scramble.why: A finish on top of the Mount Si trail, and that trail is its only way in, so there is nothing to switch between.

wa_golden_horn_southwest_route.why: Flagged FINISH because the North Face row DESCENDS it back to Snowy Lakes; both start at Rainy Pass on the PCT, and nothing describes another way in.

wa_mount_rainier_mowich_face.why: Settled on the evidence, not left open: no page shows a party reaching the North Mowich from anywhere but Mowich Lake. The row already says the road there has been cut since the April 2025 Fairfax Bridge closure. Revisit only if an ascent account describes another start.

wa_mount_persis_the_hexorcist.why: Nothing online describes how anyone reaches the north face, only the name and the first ascensionist. The row's approach already says the base is reached cross-country, from the West Ridge path or the Anderson Creek side, and that the approach is not documented. With no documented way in, there is nothing to switch between.

wa_fortress_mountain_east_ridge.why: Flagged FINISH only because the Northeast Face row says 'Southeast Ridge'. Both ways to the Chiwawa-Fortress col start at Trinity: the river trail and ford, or the Red Mountain Trail into Chiwawa Basin. One trailhead, so the second is a card (leftovers 13), not a switch.

wa_kangaroo_temple_north_face.why: Flagged FINISH because the South Face row rappels down it. Every route on the Temple is walked to from the SR-20 Hairpin over Kangaroo Pass.

wa_lost_peak_pasayten_scramble.why: Flagged OTHER_TH for Monument Creek, which is the EXIT of the loop that starts at Robinson Creek; the row itself says the upper Monument Creek trail has been unmaintained for decades and is not a way in.

wa_luna_peak_southwest_ridge.why: Empty row. The Southeast Slopes route finishes along the Southwest Ridge, so it shares the one way in: Ross Lake, Big Beaver and Access Creek. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_lundin_peak_southeast_ridge.why: Empty row. The ridge runs down to Red Pass and is the South Face's descent, back into Commonwealth Basin from the PCT trailhead. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_red_mountain_snoqualmie_west_ridge.why: Empty row. Every Red Mountain route is walked to by the PCT and Commonwealth Creek trail; the Standard Scramble goes up the west slope beside it. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_sherpa_peak_northeast_face.why: Empty row. The northeast side is reached by the Stuart Lake trail and Mountaineer Creek, like the Northeast Couloir beside it; the Esmeralda start serves only the south and west routes. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_summit_chief_mountain_southeast_face.why: Empty row. The South Route climbs the snowfield directly below this face from Pete Lake and the Vista Lakes; the Middle Fork start serves only the North Face. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_the_tooth_north_ridge.why: Empty row. It is the walk-off and the last moves of Indentured Servant; every Tooth route starts at Alpental. Needs an approach written, not a switch.

wa_a_great_northern_slab_ten_percent_var.why: A pitch variation at a roadside crag (Index Lower Town Wall), one way to its base.

wa_d_narrow_arrow_and_further_right_deat.why: A crag route above Freedom Fighter's first pitch (Index Lower Town Wall), one way to its base.

wa_private_idaho_sliding_into_first_vari.why: A pitch variation at a single crag (Private Idaho), one way to its base.

wa_castle_peak_pasayten_east_ridge.why: Empty row. The South Route row starts from the same Castle Creek Basin camp, and the only lawful way to that basin is the PCT north from Harts Pass (the Manning Park start crosses the border away from a port of entry). Needs an approach written, not a switch.
